title: GET /connected/snapshot sends the server's absolute workspace path to the browser (catalogue.workspace).
expected: The service sends no absolute path to the page: run_activity.py:230 states 'Spend, run folders and absolute paths are not sent', and /connected/library (react_frontend/__init__.py:97-116) projects the snapshot down and drops the field. FINDINGS-SCHEMA: a leaked path is High.
actual: Every report page fetches /connected/snapshot?run=<folder>; its JSON holds catalogue.workspace = '/tmp/cs-C1/root/_engine' (src/deploy_workflow/credit_os_catalogue.py:517 `"workspace": str(workspace)` passes through admission.admitted and sources.enrich unchanged). No code under web/src reads the field (grep), and nothing draws it, so it is visible only in the network response.
suggested_change: Drop catalogue.workspace (and any other server-side path) in _visible_scope the way _library_index projects its fields, or stop writing it into the published catalogue.

title: The empty Library is a bare 'No reports yet' card with no icon, no explanation and no next step, drawn under filter and layout controls that have nothing to act on.
expected: D-31: empty is the empty-state component (featured icon, title, one sentence, and the next action where one exists); D-26: sibling screens agree. Run activity's own empty state (RunActivity.tsx:212-229) is built that way, and CM-036 requires the library to say so.
actual: With no completed run the page shows the header, then a Sector select and a Pathway select that offer only 'All', the Cards/List toggle, and one white card reading 'No reports yet' (LibraryIndex.tsx:125-130). There is no sentence saying what fills the library and no 'Start a run' action in the body (the header button is the only one). A second, different empty form exists for a null index (LibraryIndex.tsx:222: the same text in a card, but with no controls). Run activity's empty state next door has icon, title, sentence and an 'Open the library' button.
suggested_change: Use the EmptyState component the Run activity page already uses (title, one sentence on what a finished run adds, 'Start a run' action) and hide the filters and Cards/List toggle while there is nothing to filter; give the null and empty-array cases one form.

screen: /runs (Run activity), full and partial; at 390, 768, 1280 and 1440 px
title: Run activity's Waiting and Ended tables are cut off inside overflow-hidden panels: the Pathway column is clipped at 1280 to 1440 px and Ended, State and Reason cannot be seen or scrolled to on a phone.
expected: D-42 (content reflows without loss; no two-axis scrolling) and D-32 (a qualification is never truncated): every column the reader needs stays reachable. CM-089 / CT-039: run state words and reason are shown on Run activity.
actual: WaitingTable and EndedTable sit in `panel overflow-hidden` wrappers (RunActivity.tsx:140,174). With Running and Waiting both present (xl two-column grid, 440 px right column, RunActivity.tsx:296-318) the Waiting table is 464 px wide in a 440 px panel, so the Pathway header and cells are cut mid-word ('Deep credit assessmen'). In the Ended table at 768 px the Ended and Reason columns lie outside the panel; at 390 px only the Issuer column is visible and State, Pathway, Ended and Reason are unreachable (no scrollbar), and rows grow to about 240 px tall because the hidden cells wrap in a narrow column. Measured with realistic issuer names (probe output).
suggested_change: Let the table wrapper scroll horizontally (overflow-x-auto, as the library List already does) or stack each row as a card below the md breakpoint; give the Waiting column a width that holds the pathway name.

title: Run and report error states are one plain red line with no icon or action, and say the wrong thing: an unknown report reads 'could not be loaded' and an unknown run reads 'unknown run'.
expected: D-31: errors are the alert component with tone by severity and an action; no raw service string. The code itself has a clear message for the case ('No report was published for this run.', ReportLibrary.tsx:424-426).
actual: ErrorNotice (layout.tsx:28-37) draws a bordered line of red text. /run/20000101-000000-01 shows the service's lowercase string 'unknown run' under an h1 that says 'Run activity' (the same words as the breadcrumb link above it). /report/no-such-run, and the report of a run that failed and published nothing, show 'The published report could not be loaded.' because the service answers 404 'unknown report' and getSnapshot turns every non-OK status into that one sentence (publishedReport.ts:255-259), so the 'No report was published for this run.' branch is never reached. Neither error offers a retry, a link to Run activity or the Library beyond the small breadcrumb.
suggested_change: Render both through the Alert component with an action (Back to Run activity / Library, Try again for non-404 statuses), map 404 to 'No report was published for this run' (and 'This run was not found'), and keep the h1 distinct from the breadcrumb.

screen: /run/<id>, finished run whose report is never published
title: A finished run with no published report polls every 2 seconds for ever and keeps saying 'Waiting for the report to become available…'.
expected: D-31: no infinite spinner or wait; a state that cannot resolve says so and offers a way out. CM-092 separates delivery from publication.
actual: RunProgress polls getReport every 2 s while the run is finished and the report answers 404 (RunProgress.tsx:60-68) and has no limit, no elapsed time and no message that the report may never appear. The page shows only the muted status line (RunProgress.tsx:140-144); no alert, no action. Reproduced with the run record finished and /connected/report/<id> answering 404: 7 polls in 12 s, text unchanged. The scheduler marks a run finished only after the library lists it (scheduler.py:495-521), so the trigger is a report that is removed, hidden by admission or not yet readable after that point, not the ordinary path; the page has no answer for it.
suggested_change: After a bounded wait (for example one minute) stop polling and state that the run finished but no report was published, with Run activity and Library links and a manual 'Check again' control.

screen: /runs (Run activity), partial (a run in progress, then ended)
title: Run activity changes run state on screen every 5 seconds but exposes no live region, so a screen-reader user is never told that a run started, ended, failed or was capped.
expected: D-43: run state and progress changes are exposed in a polite live region (role=status or aria-live) without moving focus; Medium on Run activity. WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3.
actual: RunActivity's only status role is the 'Loading run activity…' line (RunActivity.tsx:264-268), removed after the first read. While a run was running and after it moved to 'Ended without a report' the page held 0 elements with role=status, aria-live or role=alert. The per-run page does announce its state (RunProgress.tsx:96 wraps the badge in role=status), so the two screens disagree.
suggested_change: Add one polite status region that announces changes (for example 'Alpha: Running to Failed') computed from the previous and next list, not the whole list each poll.

screen: /report/<folder>#history (Report history tab of the report frame), full
title: Report history rows omit the modules run and each run's status, and no row can carry 'Earlier format' or 'Earlier methods'.
expected: CM-032: one row per run, newest first, with date, pathway, modules run and status; an earlier-format run is labelled 'Earlier format' and a run whose methods have since changed 'Earlier methods'. CM-060: 'Earlier methods' shown on Report history. docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md decision 4.
actual: RunHistory (ReportLibrary.tsx:91-125) draws, per run, the pathway name, 'As of <date>', a Finished badge on the current run only (record === run, line 116) and two links (Open overview, What changed). It draws no modules-run count or list, no status for any other run, and the strings 'Earlier format' and 'Earlier methods' appear nowhere under web/src/pages/connected (grep; only two code comments mention an earlier-format handoff). With proof.serve a second run of the same issuer cannot be made (its launcher refuses: 'synthetic proof requires a first Credit Snapshot run'), so the single-row screen was captured and the omission is shown by the code and the row text; a multi-run history was not exercised.
suggested_change: Add the modules-run count and status to every row and the two labels where the handoff or the run record says earlier format or earlier methods; the static History page (web/src/pages/library/History.tsx) already holds the row design.

title: The connected library card shows no delivery state and no bottom line, unlike the static IssuerCard it is meant to match, and shows the issuer's raw identifier as its subtitle.
expected: CM-033: issuer cards with search and filter, Cards or List, and an explicit delivery state (S1); docs/design/react-module-coverage.md:31. The static IssuerCard (web/src/pages/library/parts/IssuerCard.tsx:13-38) shows name, sector, a state badge, the lead bottom line, as-of and pathway. CM-011: ids are not drawn outside Evidence.
actual: The card (LibraryIndex.tsx:133-162) shows the name, the issuer key 'NORTHBRIDGE-SYNTHETIC-GROUP' as a muted subtitle (only when it differs from the name, line 138), pathway and date, up to six headline figures and an Open report button. It has no state badge and no lead sentence, so the first thing on the card is five numbers, not a judgement (D-01, D-11 reader standard: judgement first). All cards in the connected library are finished runs, so the missing state does not mislead today.
suggested_change: Show the run's delivery state badge and its lead bottom line on the card and replace the raw issuer key by the sector or country when the name already identifies the issuer.

title: A headline figure that was not supplied is dropped from the library card without a word, and a blank-string value would draw a tile with a label and no value.
expected: D-14: a missing figure is stated ('n.a.' / 'Not supplied'), never silently absent or blank; AGENTS.md: missing versus zero. The CP-1 handoff says 'Not supplied: the measure is not stated' for FY2024 adjusted EBITDA (proof/handoffs/CP-1.md:127).
actual: HeadlineFigures lists six metrics (HeadlineFigures.tsx:6-13) but keeps only those with value != null (line 18): the card shows five tiles and nothing says that Adjusted EBITDA was not supplied for the period (the catalogue holds no adjusted_ebitda key at all for this run). With a crafted index (value "") the Revenue tile draws the label and period with an empty value; value 0 correctly draws '$0m'. This file belongs to C3; it is drawn here on every card.
suggested_change: Draw a tile 'Adjusted EBITDA: not supplied' (the design system's missing form) for a listed metric that has no value, and treat an empty string as missing.

screen: / (library index), partial data (entry without metrics, index without workspace)
title: One malformed catalogue entry takes down the whole Library page: the user sees only 'This page could not be loaded' and a Reload button that fails the same way.
expected: D-31: a failed region is contained and says what failed; a record that cannot be drawn is not allowed to blank the home page. HeadlineFigures types metrics as required (publishedReport.ts:196-209) but the service is the only guard.
actual: A /connected/library answer whose entry lacks `metrics` throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading net_leverage)' inside HeadlineFigures (HeadlineFigures.tsx:16); an answer without `workspace` throws in MatchRuns (LibraryIndex.tsx:30). ConnectedLoadBoundary replaces the whole page, including the navigation rail, with the heading 'Credit OS', one sentence and Reload page. The entry fields are used unchecked: `[newest.name, newest.issuer, …].some(v => v.toLowerCase()…)` (LibraryIndex.tsx:58-61) also throws on any undefined text field. Browser-intercepted payloads only; the real service always sends these fields.
suggested_change: Validate the index once in getLibraryIndex (reject with the 'could not be loaded' message) or wrap each card in its own error boundary; this is parked as hostile input.

screen: /runs and /run/<id>, partial data (status, module state or event kind outside the vocabulary)
title: A run status, module state or event kind the client does not know crashes the whole Run activity or run page into the load-failure screen.
expected: api.ts:92-97 says the service 'sends these words and no others' and tests/test_react_frontend.py holds them; a newer or older service must still leave the page readable (D-31, no blank or crashed screen).
actual: EndedTable calls StatusBadge with ENDED[run.status] (RunActivity.tsx:191); an unknown status gives `unknown status state "undefined"`, thrown by StatusBadge, and the whole page is replaced by 'This page could not be loaded'. The same happens for a module state outside waiting/running/done/stopped (STEP[state], RunActivity.tsx:117) and for an event kind outside MILESTONES (runFigures.ts:116 destructures undefined: 'undefined is not iterable'). Run activity re-reads every 5 s, so one bad record hides every run. Browser-intercepted payloads only.
suggested_change: Fall back to a neutral 'Unknown state' badge and a generic feed line for words outside the tables; parked as hostile input.

screen: / (library index) and /report/<folder> (report frame), error: non-JSON answer
title: getLibraryIndex and getSnapshot hand the browser's JSON parse error to the reader ('Unexpected token '<', "<html>oops</html>" is not valid JSON').
expected: D-31: no raw error string. api.ts request() already guards this case (api.ts:173-193: json().catch(() => null), then a plain sentence), so the two publishedReport fetchers are inconsistent with it.
actual: publishedReport.ts:248-259 call `response.json()` unguarded; when the service answers 200 with a page that is not JSON (an interposed proxy, a half-written file) the ErrorNotice shows the SyntaxError text. Seen on the Library page with an intercepted answer.
suggested_change: Reuse request() (or the same json().catch) in both fetchers so every failure reads as a sentence.

title: Run reasons are drawn exactly as the scheduler wrote them: launcher exit codes and log paths, and (from the library's refusals) module codes such as 'CP-1' and delivery file paths.
expected: R-13 / D-13 / owner amendment 2026-11-12: a CP- code is shown nowhere on run activity; D-31: no raw error string; CM-011: file names, hashes and ids stay off reader pages. api.ts:427 serviceText() exists to turn codes in service text into module names.
actual: A run the launcher refused ended 'Failed' with 'launcher exited 2; see logs/20261117-080332-01.log', shown in the red alert of /run/<id> (RunProgress.tsx:129) and the Reason column of Ended without a report (RunActivity.tsx:194); the page has no link to that log. For a run the launcher finished but the library refused, scheduler.py:517 stores 'not listed: <why>' and the <why> strings of library_index.py (for example 'the delivery does not record CP-1's handoff', '<module>: its answer is not in a CP-OS request folder', 'deliveries/<sha>/view.json is missing') pass through run_activity._shown, which only strips the root path. RunActivity and RunProgress draw run.reason, held and held_reason without serviceText, so on an intercepted answer carrying such a reason the page shows 'CP-1' and the delivery path verbatim.
suggested_change: Pass every service-written string through serviceText (and a path/hash scrubber) before drawing it, and map the scheduler's own failure reasons to plain sentences; keep the raw reason in the run record and the operator log.

title: Every connected page except the report is titled 'Credit OS', so tabs, history entries and screen-reader page announcements cannot tell Library, Run activity and a run apart.
expected: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.2 (page titled) and D-36 (the page title names the page); the report frame already sets 'Overview — <issuer> — Credit OS' (ReportLibrary.tsx:444-450).
actual: document.title is 'Credit OS' on /, /runs, /run/<id> and /start (connected.html:11 is the only source); only /report/<folder> changes it. Seen with Playwright on each route.
suggested_change: Set the title per screen in the same way (Library — Credit OS, Run activity — Credit OS, <issuer> run — Credit OS).

title: Heading levels skip: the Library goes from the h1 straight to h3 issuer names, and the run page from h1 to h3 'Modules' and 'Activity'.
expected: D-36: h1, then h2 for sections, h3 below; no skipped level going down.
actual: LibraryIndex.tsx:136 draws each card title as h3 with no h2 above it. The run page uses Card titles that render h3 under the page h1 (RunProgress.tsx:154,165). Run activity itself is correct (h1, h2 groups).
suggested_change: Use h2 for the card titles and the two run-page cards.

title: The Cards/List toggle is announced as a radio group, but the arrow keys only move focus: List is not selected until Space or Enter is pressed.
expected: D-35 and the WAI-ARIA radio-group pattern: in role=radiogroup an arrow key moves focus and checks the next radio. The accessibility tree reports radiogroup 'Layout' with radios 'Cards' and 'List'.
actual: Focus on Cards, ArrowRight: focus moves to List and aria-checked stays false; Space then selects it. The behaviour comes from the ButtonGroup component (web/src/components/base/button-group, section X1), used at LibraryIndex.tsx:111-123. Tab leaves the group after one stop (roving focus), as expected.
suggested_change: Either select on arrow (selectionBehavior replace) or expose the control as two toggle buttons with aria-pressed instead of a radio group.

title: Text smaller than 13 px is drawn on Run activity and the run page: table headings and the 'submitted by' line, the three Summary captions and the activity times (12 px).
expected: D-30: nothing under 13 px; no ignore in .impeccable/config.json covers web/src (the two ignored values name one mockup file).
actual: Measured computed font sizes: 12 px on 'Issuer'/'Pathway' table heads and the Waiting row's 'submitted by … · 2 source files' (text-xs, RunActivity.tsx:158), on 'Cap usage', 'Modules finished' and 'Elapsed' (Summary.tsx:18) and on the Feed times (Feed.tsx:53); the rail labels at 390 px are 12 px too (shell, S1). The table heads come from the table component in components/application/table.
suggested_change: Raise those sizes to the 13 px caption token; leave table-head sizing to X1.

title: On a Running card each module is a status badge whose word is the module's name, so a sighted reader sees the state only as a small glyph and colour; the state word exists for screen readers only.
expected: D-29 and D-24: a status badge is leading shape + the state's word + status colour; one state, one word. StatusBadge's own comment says 'say the state beside it' (StatusBadge.tsx:30-31).
actual: RunningCard renders StatusBadge with label=moduleName(code) and a separate `sr-only` span carrying the state (RunActivity.tsx:115-121). The visible cards read 'Source readiness', 'Financial foundation', 'Fundamental credit', 'Report' with a filled, half-filled or ring glyph and no word; the run page's own list (ModuleSteps) shows the word. 'Report' also appears as a fourth badge while the bar says '1 of 3 modules'.
suggested_change: Show the module name as text and the state as the badge word (as ModuleSteps does), or put the state word in a visible title attribute-free label beside the glyph.

screen: / (library index), partial: after opening a report and pressing Back
title: The Library search text, Sector and Pathway filters and the Cards/List choice are lost when the reader opens a report and comes back.
expected: Wiring check: state after Back/forward. A reader who searched, filtered and opened an issuer expects the same list when returning.
actual: Links are full page navigations; the filter state lives only in React state (LibraryIndex.tsx:207-211,29). Typed 'north', chose List, opened 'Open report', pressed Back: the search box was empty and Cards was selected again.
suggested_change: Keep the query, filters and layout in the address (search params) so Back and a copied link restore them.

title: On the Report history tab the report frame is wider than a phone screen: the page scrolls sideways (6 px at 390 px, 76 px at 320 px) because each history row's right-hand cluster does not wrap.
expected: D-42: content reflows to 320 px without horizontal scrolling of the page.
actual: RunHistory's right cluster is `flex items-center gap-3` with a status badge and two links (ReportLibrary.tsx:115-119). Its minimum width widens the report grid column, so the identity band and the tab bar also end at 396 px (measured right edge of NAV and SECTION = 396 px in a 390 px viewport). The Overview tab on the same run does not overflow.
suggested_change: Let the cluster wrap (flex-wrap) and give the grid column min-w-0.

screen: /runs at 390 px (Running card, Waiting and Ended rows) and 320 px (header)
title: Issuer names on Run activity are links that never wrap, so an 85-character name makes the page scroll sideways 737 px at 390 px; at 320 px the header's counts and Start a run button also overflow.
expected: D-32 and D-42: long text wraps in full; no sideways scrolling of the page.
actual: TextLink is built from the button base class `whitespace-nowrap` (components/base/buttons/button.tsx:15; web/src/pages/run/TextLink.tsx:6-17). RunningCard puts the issuer name in one (RunActivity.tsx:95), so a long name sets the card's minimum width (measured scrollWidth 737 px in a 390 px viewport). At 320 px the header actions row (Running/Waiting/Ended counts plus Start a run) is 357 px wide (RunActivity.tsx:249-260). Names up to about 45 characters fit at 390 px.
suggested_change: Add whitespace-normal and break-words to TextLink when it holds a name, and let the header actions wrap below sm.

title: The Library filter bar labels its three fields in two styles: 'Search issuers' is a medium-weight primary-colour label above a wide input; 'Sector' and 'Pathway' are lighter secondary-colour labels above small selects.
expected: D-26: sibling elements share type, colour and spacing.
actual: layout.tsx:8 `label` (text-sm font-medium text-text-primary, gap-1.5) is used for Search; the selects use `grid gap-1 text-sm text-text-secondary` (LibraryIndex.tsx:72,91). The screenshot shows different weight, colour and label-to-field gaps on adjacent fields.
suggested_change: Use the one label style for all three fields.

title: The same as-of date is written three ways on sibling screens: '2025-03-31' on the library card and run page, 'As of 31 March 2025' on the report header, and '17 Nov 2026, 07:57 UTC' stamps on Run activity.
expected: D-26: sibling screens agree; the report badges and the run page both carry 'As of'.
actual: Library card <time>2025-03-31</time> (LibraryIndex.tsx:145); run page badge 'As of 2025-03-31' (RunProgress.tsx:104); report badge 'As of 31 March 2025' (runTiming, publishedReport.ts:297-301). Run activity stamps use stamp() (runFigures.ts:52-66).
suggested_change: Use one long form for an as-of date everywhere a reader meets it.

screen: /run/<id>, finished run whose report request keeps failing (non-404)
title: The run page removes and re-inserts its red error alert on every 2-second poll, so a screen reader announces the same error again every cycle and the line flickers.
expected: D-43: an alert needs no re-announcement while its text is unchanged and never steals attention on each poll; live regions exist before the change.
actual: RunProgress.poll calls setError('') after every successful getRun (RunProgress.tsx:57) and then, in the finished branch, sets the report error again after the getReport request fails (lines 64-67). With /connected/report/<id> answering 500, a MutationObserver counted 5 insertions and 4 removals of the role=alert element in 11 s (5 report polls). Each insertion of a role=alert node is announced assertively.
suggested_change: Keep the poll error and the report error in separate state and clear each only on its own success; or set the error only when its text changes.

title: The library index sends 43 KB for one run, almost all of it fields the page never reads (artifacts, files, gaps, summary, workflow, country, currency).
expected: Stage 6 measure: a list page asks for the fields it draws. LibraryIndex and HeadlineFigures read id, name, issuer, title, date, sector, period and metrics only.
actual: GET /connected/library for one finished run returned 43,351 bytes: catalogue.real[0] carries artifacts[] and files[] with delivery paths and file names, gaps, summary and more (react_frontend/__init__.py:97-116 keeps the whole catalogue entry). The page is re-fetched on each visit (cache: no-store).
suggested_change: Project catalogue.real to the eight fields the page draws, as _library_index already does for workspace.runs.

screen: ConnectedApp routing: /start/, /runs/, unknown address; ReportReader 'no report' branch
title: Several client branches cannot be reached through the service: trailing-slash /start/ and /runs/, the 'Page not found' page, and 'No report was published for this run.'
expected: Code check: no branch that no input reaches. The service's own page list (_app_page, react_frontend/__init__.py:235-243) is what decides which addresses reach the client.
actual: ConnectedApp matches path === '/start/' and '/runs/' (ConnectedApp.tsx:64,66) but the service answers GET /start/ and GET /runs/ with 404 {"error":"not found"} (it serves /run/<id>/ and /report/<id>/ with a trailing slash only). The Page-not-found PageHeader (ConnectedApp.tsx:82) is reached by no address the service serves; the browser shows the JSON 404 instead. ReaderStatus's 'No report was published for this run.' (ReportLibrary.tsx:424-426) is unreachable because the service answers 404 for an unknown folder and getSnapshot throws. ConnectedLoadBoundary's `reload` prop and ConnectedApp's `navigate`/`search` props are test seams no production caller passes.
suggested_change: Either serve the trailing-slash forms and a real not-found page, or delete the branches (stage 6).

title: Spend and cap are rounded through binary floating point, so an exact decimal ending in 5 can show one cent low ('3.105' draws USD 3.10).
expected: AGENTS.md: preserve exact amounts. The service sends exact fixed-point text (pricing.money_text, 'format(amount, "f")').
actual: runFigures.ts:10 usd() is Number(text).toFixed(2): '3.105' gives 3.10, '1.005' gives 1.00, '2.675' gives 2.67; decimal half-up rounding gives 3.11, 1.01, 2.68. Only exact ties are affected, and amounts settle in many decimals, so it is rare; the bar value is clamped to the cap separately (Math.min).
suggested_change: Round the decimal text itself (string arithmetic or a decimal helper) instead of a float.

screen: /run/<id>, full: module list; control matrix CT-040, CT-038
title: The connected Run activity has no 'Not assessable' state for a blocked module, and offers 'Start from this run' beside a capped or interrupted run where the matrix records no resume control.
expected: CT-040: a blocked module appears as 'Not assessable' on the module page, the navigator and Run activity. CT-038: resume of an interrupted or capped run has no page control; the user relaunches into the same folder.
actual: The service's module state is waiting, running, done or stopped only (src/deploy_workflow/run_events.py:22); moduleWord (runFigures.ts:127-132) never returns 'Not assessable' although ModuleWord allows it, so a blocked module that delivered its Blocked handoff shows as Finished on the run page. For failed, capped, rejected and interrupted runs the page offers 'Start from this run' (RunProgress.tsx:35,114-119), which opens a new run with the earlier inputs (a new folder, a new cap and new spend), not a resume. Neither could be exercised: the synthetic proof has no blocked module or capped run.
suggested_change: none

title: The stage 0 inventory attributes the report frame's controls to C3, C4 and C5, and omits the boundary's Reload page button and the list-layout links by name.
expected: sections.md assigns the frame of /report/<folder> (breadcrumb, header, Show sources switch, six tab links, Run activity button) to C1; a control missing from the inventory is a finding against stage 0.
actual: The inventory lists those controls only under C3 (17 lines each), C4 (2) and C5 (8); C1 has 29 lines, none on /report. 'Reload page' (ConnectedLoadBoundary, web/src/ConnectedLoadBoundary.tsx:20-31) appears nowhere. All were operated for this audit: breadcrumb Library, Run activity, the six tab links (mouse, keyboard, Back/Forward, titles), Show sources (Space), and Reload page (Tab to focus, Enter reloads and recovers).
suggested_change: none

screen: Connected shell rail at 390 px, full (S1 component)
title: At 390 px the navigation rail is drawn at the bottom of the screen but is first in the tab order, so keyboard focus starts at the bottom bar, jumps to the top for 'Start a run', and never returns to it in reading order.
expected: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.3 and D-35: focus order follows the visual and reading order. Seen on C1's screens (how C1 uses the shell); the file belongs to S1 (web/src/shell/Shell.tsx).
actual: Shell renders the aside before main and moves it with `order-last` below 768 px (Shell.tsx:50). On / at 390 px the Tab order was: Skip to content, Library (y=839), Run (y=839), Start a run (y=74), Sector, Pathway, Cards. At 1440 px the order matches the layout.
suggested_change: Render the rail after main in the DOM at narrow widths (or use CSS order on main) so focus order equals visual order.

title: When one poll of Run activity fails, every run and the counts disappear behind a neutral empty-state panel with a magnifier icon, no alert role and no tone; the same icon is used for 'No run in progress'.
expected: D-31: an error or system message is the alert component with tone by severity and an action, announced politely (D-43); D-20: an icon carries meaning. The page's design intent is 'a failed read is shown as unreadable, never as empty' (RunActivity.tsx:49).
actual: useActivity turns any failed or malformed poll into 'unreadable' (RunActivity.tsx:56-58), and the page then draws <Empty title='Run activity could not be read'> (RunActivity.tsx:269-274): the EmptyState with its default SearchLg magnifier, grey text and one 'Open the library' button. It has no role=alert or status, so nothing is announced, and it looks the same as the real empty state.
